usage: A basic countable noun for a newspaper. It is used for printed news media, not for “news” in general.
Commonly used with verbs like 睇, 買, 送, and 揀. In daily speech, people may also use it when talking about old-style paper newspapers versus online news.
You can say 一份報紙 to mean one copy of a newspaper. The measure word 份 is the natural choice here.
Neutral and very common in everyday Cantonese. It fits both casual conversation and general written language.
